name: Alivio front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 146 g for the FD-MC10 bottom-pull clamp front derailleur. Its sole documented band fits 28.0–28.6 mm; larger bands and top-route options in the adjacent column belong to FD-MC11.
